address: Mile 1413.5 Alaska Highway, Delta Junction, Alaska

feeding_claim.verbatim: That freshness equates to a more enhanced flavor when the hogs are finished on Alaskan Grown Barley.

resold_note: Also sells bison, elk, yak and reindeer products and eggs; the site lists other producers and does not say these are raised on the farm.
notes: USDA inspected plant and retail store (store is at the processing plant on the Alaska Highway, not confirmed as on the farm; on-farm-store used as the closest value). Animals come from the family farm Northwest Land & Livestock (Doug and Cathie McCollum), which raises Galloway cross cattle and Berkshire cross hogs. Beef: summer grass pasture, brome hay in winter, and the homepage says feed is supplemented with a small portion of Alaska Grown ground barley; about page says brome hay with a small amount of ground barley, market at 20 to 22 months. Hogs are finished on barley. Category set to grain-finished as the cautious choice; percentage could also fit for the beef. Orders by phone (also toll free 800-794-4206). Site says it delivers to Fairbanks and arranges ground or air transport to other places inside and outside Alaska; no other states named, so ships_to set to AK only. Sells sides of beef and pork. Retail and food service outlets (for example 49th State Brewing, Three Bears Tok) listed on the resources page. Also does custom game processing. Prices are in a PDF price list not read. No zip on the site.
